description: Andreew Mikhail, from Russia, has studied Xingyiquan for over 18 years under renowned master Sun Xu in Hengshui, north China. He is dedicated to promoting Chinese martial arts by creating a Xingyiquan association in Moscow, and introduced the practice to other cities across Russia.
title: Russian Xingyiquan enthusiast promotes Chinese martial art

author: New China TV
description:
Fresh footage from the Wolong area of Giant Panda National Park in southwest China's Sichuan Province has captured the world's only known wild white panda roaming through snow-covered forests and bamboo groves.
The rare albino giant panda, first discovered in 2019, now appears healthy, strong and fully adapted to life in the wild. Researchers say the footage, recorded between 2024 and 2026, provides valuable insight into the growth and survival of this extraordinarily rare animal.#Panda #Wildlife #Biodiversity
title: World's Only Wild White Panda Spotted Again in Southwest China

description: Only around 850 Guizhou snub-nosed monkeys remain in the wild, all hidden deep within the mountains of southwest China's Guizhou. Join Xinhua as we follow rangers and researchers to see how they work to protect one of the world's rarest primates in Mount Fanjingshan, a UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site. (recorded) #Guizhou #GoldenMonkey #Wildlife #Nature #Conservation #Biodiversity
title: Searching for China's rare golden monkeys in world natural heritage site
